parents.subject: South Asian and Middle Eastern Studies

ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: At the Center of the Storm: The Gulf States in the Modern World Description: The countries of Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates and Oman are interesting not only for their rich shared history, but because they provide opportunities to study key global challenges of the 21st century. States in the Gulf both profit from and struggle to address the globalization of labor and financial markets, the looming impact of environmental crises, and the rise of post-national identities. This class will review the modern history of the region with a focus on the tension between tribal, global and nation-state political formations, the impact of rapid economic transformation on culture and society, and the transformations spurred by new technologies of communication, the rise of non-state actors, and the impact of regional competitions and conflicts.
